title: Loop 1604 / U. S. Highway 181

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located on the north corner of U. S. Highway 181 and Southeast Loop 1604.

rows.label: Frontage
rows.text:
Approximately 502.25 feet along Loop 1604
Approximately 619.44 feet along Highway 181
Approximately 246.86 feet along Laguna Road

rows.label: Utilities
pairs: City Public Service indicates it has a 3-phase line along S. E. Loop 1604.
The City of Elmendorf indicates it has a 6 inch water main along Highway 181 and S. E. Loop 1604 on the property frontage.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and available capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: The property is outside the city limits.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for the property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U. S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Most recent (2025) Texas Department of Transportation maps indicate 23,338 vehicles per day on U. S. Highway 181 just northwest of the property and 25,093 vehicles per day southeast of the intersection. The maps also show 6,593 vehicles on Loop 1604 northeast of its intersection with Highway 181 and 7,936 vehicles per day southwest of the intersection.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: Federal Emergency Management Agency maps do not appear to indicate any 100-year flood plain on the property

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The property is generally level to a gentle northerly slope.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: There are two electrical easements to service the property.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: Developments at the intersection area include a Valero C-Store, Texas Best Travel Center and The Hickory Ridge Subdivision.

rows.label: Potential Use
rows.text: The property’s major intersection location offers opportunity for a variety of retail and commercial services.

comments: The corner location makes the site one of the most appealing development options in the area.
The property is located at a signalized intersection.

pages.annotations: Image-only page. Pape-Dawson preliminary site plan 'BILL MILLER LOOP 1604 & US HWY 181, BEXAR COUNTY, TEXAS - SITE PLAN EXHIBIT' (Job 13391-00, July 2026) over aerial. qa_notes: DEMOGRAPHIC OVERVIEW TYPO: Households 2025 Estimate, 7.0 Miles is printed '11.565' (period instead of comma); Owner-Occupied 10,223 + Renter-Occupied 1,342 = 11,565, so it should read 11,565. Transcribed as printed.

TITLE MISMATCH: cover title is 'LOOP 1604 / U. S. HIGHWAY 181' with city 'SAN ANTONIO, TEXAS'; Prismic title is 'Loop 1604 at Highway 181, Elmendorf' and the demographic page says 'LOOP 1604 AT HIGHWAY 181'. The water utility is from the City of Elmendorf.

ZONING MISMATCH (wording): PDF says 'The property is outside the city limits.'; Prismic zoning says 'Bexar County San Antonio ETJ' (the site-plan inset map on p6 does show the site in the City of San Antonio ETJ, Bexar County).
SIZE: spec 3.08 Acres; site plan LOT 2 ±3.08 AC; Prismic 3.08 acres (match). The cover has no acreage line, so size_headline is blank.
PRICE: 'Contact Broker' in PDF and Prismic (match).

TRANSACTION: the PDF never says 'For Sale'/'For Lease'; set to 'For Sale' (Investment row, pad site). Prismic transaction_type is null. The site plan (p6) now shows the 3.08 ac as Lot 2 of a three-lot Bill Miller plan with a c-store/gas concept - broker should confirm the offering (sale vs. ground lease/pad) is still as described.

FRONTAGE: printed as three unlabelled sentences (not label/value pairs), so kept as text with line breaks. Worth verifying: the site plan shows Lot 2 fronting Highway 181 and Laguna Rd with Loop 1604 across Laguna Rd; the 502.25 ft 'along Loop 1604' figure may describe the original larger tract.

Traffic Count omits 'per day' in '6,593 vehicles on Loop 1604' (other three counts say 'vehicles per day'). Flood Plain sentence has no closing period. Contact line prints 'Email' without a colon. All kept as printed.
Spec-page demographics use '3 - mile' / '5 - mile' headers and match the overview (5,733 / 14,214; $88,337 / $97,848). Overview includes a 7.0-mile column not on the spec page.
Prismic highlight 1 reads 'Corner location makes the site...' whereas the PDF comment reads 'The corner location makes the site...'.
